GET /analytics/sql.description: Executes a SQL query against the analytics datasets available to the caller. SQL placeholders can be bound with query parameters named `param_<name>`, such as `param_status=404` for `$status`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.example: SELECT edgeResponseStatus FROM events.httpRequests WHERE accountTag = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef' AND datetime > '2026-01-01' LIMIT 10

data.description: Query result rows keyed by the selected column names.

bytes_read.description: Number of source bytes read while executing the query.

rows_read.description: Number of source rows read while executing the query.

400.description: The request is malformed, or authentication was rejected by the API gateway before the request reached the SQL service.

error_chain.description: Additional errors that caused this error.
Additional errors that caused this error.
Additional errors that caused this error.

403.description: Authentication failed or the caller is not authorized.

422.description: The SQL query or its parameters are invalid.

429.description: The query exceeded a resource or request-rate limit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present when the account request rate limit is exceeded; omitted for query resource limits.

501.description: The query uses a SQL feature that is not implemented.

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable.

GET /analytics/sql/introspection.description:
Returns the analytics dataset catalogue. By default, the response contains dataset names, titles, descriptions, and kinds. Set `include_columns` to include each dataset's column names, descriptions, and data types. The caller must have Account Analytics Read permission on the account identified by `account_tag`. Dataset names, descriptions, and columns are the same for every authorized account. When `include_custom_attributes` is set, the response also includes custom attribute names and types discovered from that account's own data, which legitimately differs per caller.

The catalogue lists the datasets this deployment is able to describe, which is not a fixed list. Some datasets are described by the service that owns them and are listed only where that service is available, so the same account may see a different catalogue in different environments, and datasets may appear or disappear without a change to this API. Clients should query the catalogue rather than hard-coding it, and should not treat a dataset's absence as proof that it does not exist.

Workers Analytics Engine datasets are named by the account that writes them, so they are discovered from that account's own data rather than from a fixed list. They appear as `events.analyticsEngine.<dataset_name>` and differ per account. A dataset is listed for as long as any of its data is retained, so it does not disappear from the catalogue merely because writes have stopped. An account with a very large number of datasets may receive a truncated list. Set `include_wae=false` to omit them.

Log Explorer datasets are listed only where the account has them, so they differ per account and are not part of the static catalogue. Set `include_lex=false` to omit them.

parameters.name: account_tag
parameters.description: Account whose available analytics datasets are returned.

parameters.name: include_columns
parameters.description: Include column metadata for each returned dataset.

parameters.name: include_custom_attributes
parameters.description: Include a capped set of custom attribute names and types observed during the preceding seven days. Requires a nonempty dataset_name.

parameters.name: include_wae
parameters.description: Include Workers Analytics Engine datasets, which are discovered from the account's own data. Set to `false` to return only datasets described from the static catalogue, which avoids that lookup.

parameters.name: include_lex
parameters.description: Include Log Explorer datasets, which are listed only where the account has them. Set to `false` to return only datasets described from the static catalogue, which avoids that lookup.

parameters.name: dataset_name
parameters.description:
Return only the dataset with this exact name. An empty value is treated as if the parameter had been omitted, and does not filter the catalogue. A name that matches no dataset in this deployment's catalogue is rejected with `422`; a dataset that exists but is not describable here is rejected identically, so the two cases cannot be told apart.

A Workers Analytics Engine dataset is named in full, as `events.analyticsEngine.<dataset_name>`; the namespace on its own returns every such dataset the account has. A `dataset_name` the account does not have is rejected with `422` like any other unknown name.

datasets.description: Datasets visible through the Analytics SQL API.

data_type.description: SQL data type of the column.

name.description: Column name used in SQL queries.

custom_attributes.description: Present when `include_custom_attributes` is true and the dataset supports custom attributes.

data_type.description: ClickHouse type of the attribute value.

kind.description: What kind of dataset this is. Determines aggregation rules and sampling behavior. Exactly one of `events`, `states`, or `logs` is present.

availability.description: Scopes the dataset is enabled for, as reported by the service that owns it. Absent when availability is not applicable to the dataset.

scope.description: Whether the dataset is enabled for the whole account or for a single zone.

zone.description: Zone tag. Present only when `scope` is `zone`.

events.description: Row-per-event analytics dataset. Aggregations describe the cumulative effect of those events.

sampling.description: Whether the dataset is sampled. `unsampled` means every row is recorded. `adaptive` means Adaptive Bit Rate (ABR) sampling is applied, and aggregates must be weighted accordingly.

logs.description: Row-per-log dataset intended for record retrieval.

sampling.description: Whether the dataset is sampled. `unsampled` means every row is recorded. `adaptive` means Adaptive Bit Rate (ABR) sampling is applied, and aggregates must be weighted accordingly.

states.description: Snapshot/state dataset. Only `valid_aggregations` are valid aggregations for this dataset.

sampling.description: Whether the dataset is sampled. `unsampled` means every row is recorded. `adaptive` means Adaptive Bit Rate (ABR) sampling is applied, and aggregates must be weighted accordingly.

valid_aggregations.description: Which aggregation function names are allowed for this dataset.

name.description: Dataset name used in SQL queries.

400.description: The request is malformed, or authentication was rejected by the API gateway before the request reached the SQL service.

error_chain.description: Additional errors that caused this error.
Additional errors that caused this error.
Additional errors that caused this error.

403.description: Authentication failed or the caller does not have Account Analytics Read permission on the specified account.

422.description: The request could not be processed. This is returned when the account tag is invalid or unknown, when `include_custom_attributes` is set without a `dataset_name`, when a Workers Analytics Engine `dataset_name` is supplied alongside `include_wae=false` or contains characters a dataset name cannot contain, or when the supplied criteria match no dataset that this deployment can describe — either because no such dataset exists or because it is not describable here. The message names the criteria that matched nothing.

text/plain.example: Input was invalid: There are no introspectable datasets matching the provided criteria (dataset_name=`events.nonexistent`)

503.description: The authorization service is temporarily unavailable.

POST /analytics/sql.description: Executes a SQL query against the analytics datasets available to the caller. Send either raw SQL or a JSON object containing the query and optional positional or named parameters, time range, and account or zone scope. Raw SQL placeholders can also be bound with query parameters named `param_<name>`.

params.description: Positional array values for `$1`, `$2`, and similar placeholders, or named object values for placeholders such as `$status`.

scope.description: Account or zone scope applied to the query. Include exactly one scope tag. Do not include account or zone tenancy predicates in the SQL query when this field is present.

accountTag.description: Account tag used to authorize and scope the query. Must be a 32-character lowercase hex string.

zoneTag.description: Zone tag used to authorize and scope the query. Must be a 32-character lowercase hex string.

time_range.description: Time bounds applied to the dataset's timestamp column. Do not include timestamp predicates in the SQL query when this field is present.

end.description: Inclusive upper bound for the dataset's timestamp column.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound for the dataset's timestamp column.

example.query: SELECT edgeResponseStatus FROM events.httpRequests WHERE edgeResponseStatus = $status LIMIT 10

text/plain.example: SELECT edgeResponseStatus FROM events.httpRequests WHERE accountTag = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef' AND datetime > '2026-01-01' LIMIT 10
